versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Shuangseqiu Generator (双色球玄学版)
- Generates personalized Super Lotto numbers using Chinese metaphysics (birthday, name, zodiac, constellation)
- Incorporates 八字五行, 生肖、星座幸运数, and 运势 analysis for weighted random number selection
- Customizable input parameters: birthday (required), name, zodiac, constellation, and group count
- Output includes lucky numbers, fortune analysis, lucky color, and direction
- Deterministic results—same input yields the same numbers; supports multiple sets
